plugin.name: Anonymous NetEase Music
plugin.description: Search NetEase Music anonymously and safely submit playback only for one clear, publicly available match
plugin.short_description: Anonymously search and play an exact NetEase Music match
entry.play.name: Play a NetEase Music song
entry.play.description: Call only when the user explicitly asks to play a specific song on NetEase Music. Format query as “title artist” and preserve live, cover, or version qualifiers. Do not use for lyrics, song facts, general recommendations, playlists, pause, stop, skip, or next-track requests.
entry.play.param.query: Song search phrase, preferably “title artist”, with at most 100 characters
messages.no_results: No matching NetEase Music song was found. Try a more specific title or artist.
messages.unavailable: This song has no publicly available source for anonymous playback. It may require sign-in or a membership.
messages.candidates.header: Several results may match. Nothing was played to avoid choosing the wrong song:
messages.candidates.hint: Please try again with the title plus the artist or version.
errors.missing_target: The current playback session could not be determined, so the request was cancelled.
errors.search_failed: NetEase Music search is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.media_failed: The NetEase Music source could not be validated, so no playback was submitted.
errors.delivery_failed: The playback action could not be submitted, and playback did not start.
